_description: Provider (SportsGameOdds) player-name spellings that do not match the engine's Sleeper canonical name after normalize_name(). Both provider_name and engine_name are run through normalize_name() at lookup time, so exact casing/spacing/punctuation here does not matter -- only the underlying words do. Seeded 2026-09-12 from the 17 of 372 lined players unmatched by name in one live fetch. One of those 17, De'Von Achane, needed no alias: normalize_name's punctuation hardening (apostrophes/periods dropped, not turned into a word break) resolves 'Devon Achane' to 'De'Von Achane' on its own. The remaining 16 are seeded here, one nickname/legal-name mismatch (Chigoziem Okonokwo -> Chig Okonkwo) doubling as a provider misspelling ('Okonokwo' vs the correct 'Okonkwo').

aliases.note: Found in a later verification fetch, not one of the original 17 -- provider dropped the space after the period.
